title: Interleaved Cycle Orbit: capacity arbitration, staffing multipliers, and progressive scope-offloading
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: multiple initiatives across Platform, Runtime, and Console are contending for a finite pool of specialist ICs (kernel engineers, infra SREs, and console UX). Current cadence uses ad-hoc reprioritization and manual seat-shifting which causes churn and missed SLAs. Goal: define an operational protocol ("Interleaved Cycle Orbit") that standardizes how we 1) arbitrate capacity across initiatives mid-cycle, 2) apply staffing multipliers to predict velocity under partial staff allocation, and 3) progressively offload scope to an explicit runway/backlog when load crosses thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: A signed playbook document (Confluence) describing orbit windows, arbitration roles, and escalation paths
A lightweight scoring rubric for computing initiative load and staffing multiplier which can be calculated in < 5 minutes per initiative
A pilot run in one cycle with two cross-functional initiatives showing reduced mid-cycle replanning meetings from weekly to ad-hoc only
A small tool (spreadsheet or script) that projects delivered story points under partial staffing multipliers and publishes to the Cycle Dashboard
Post-pilot retrospective with recommendations and a decision to adopt, iterate, or retire the playbook
